name: Hello Vue Components
summary: Example Vue component library built with Vue CLI 3, showing how to publish and register components.
description: An example component library built with Vue CLI 3, used as a reference for packaging Vue components. It documents three ways to consume the library: dropping it in with a script tag alongside Vue, installing it with npm in a module system, or importing individually packaged components to reduce application size.
contains: example component library built with Vue CLI 3
usage via script tag, npm module system, or individually packaged components
